Hi, I recently did a cataract surgery for my aunt in Agarwal hospital Ambattur Branch and was asked to buy a eyewear for my Aunt to use after surgery, The eyewear was bought for Rs 999 at the hospital and within 2 days the Frame was broken due to poor quality of the frame, Now when I approached the hospital on why you sell such poor quality frames at such exorbitant prices, the response from the staff was not acceptable saying it is the patient mistake and eyewaer cannot be replaced as my aunt used some pasting gum to fix the eyewear since she do not have spare one and the Doctor advised that she must wear the eyewear for 3-4 days but your staffs mentioned it is poor handling issue and trying to deviate the issue in a different direction,instead of addressing the quality issue

Just want to point out that my aunt was using spectacles more than 20 years and never faced these kind of issues with other brands, Can you answer me why you are selling poor quality eyewears in the hospital and why not caring about patient hastle that they undergo for buying such poor quality products from your hospital

Can you take necessary action to not sell poor quality eyewears which impacts the great service you are doing to the community

reviews.snippet:
The hospital is very clean, well-maintained, and has a modern setup. From the reception to the consultation rooms, everything feels professional and hygienic. Waiting areas are also comfortable.

👨‍⚕️ Doctors & Staff – 4.5/5

The ophthalmologists here are highly qualified and experienced. They explain the condition and treatment clearly, with patience. Staff are polite, though at times a bit slow during busy hours. But overall, they handle patients well.

⏱️ Waiting Time – 3.5/5

If you walk in without an appointment, be prepared to wait, especially in peak hours. Booking in advance is highly recommended. Some branches handle the crowd better than others.

💸 Pricing & Transparency – 4/5

Consultation and treatment charges are on the slightly higher side, but the quality justifies it. They’re transparent about the cost before procedures, which is a plus.

👓 Treatment Quality – 5/5

Be it cataract surgery, LASIK, or basic eye checkups – they use advanced equipment and follow proper protocols. Post-treatment care is also good.
